label: main season
summary: Recommend cancellation by non-technical survey: two different first-hand users report 12 and 24 years of safe use, meeting the national threshold. The evidence log contains no direct or target indirect evidence; the nearest recorded accident is within 1 km, not inside the area. The decision check passes.
flags: For sign-off: confirm the desk-study distinction that the nearest past accident is within 1 km and is not recorded inside SAB-0246. The zone flag and survey priority indicate where to visit, not evidence about contamination.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
There is no direct evidence and no indirect evidence of class 1 to 4, and every item of weaker indirect evidence is explained by evidence of absence of class 1 to 4.
2 different reliable source(s) report at least 5 years of safe use (E1; E2); the criteria need 2.
No past landmine accident is recorded inside the area.

E1.quote: We have hunted and fished along these streams for 12 years. Nobody has found anything, and nobody has been hurt.
E1.note: First-hand land user reports 12 years of safe hunting and fishing, meeting the five-year absence criterion; no weaker indirect item is identified for it to explain.

E2.quote: she has walked the trail across the area to the school every year for the past 24 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E2.note: First-hand source regularly crosses the area and reports 24 years without finding anything or hearing of an accident, exceeding the five-year safe-use criterion; no weaker indirect item is identified for it to explain.
